D: Barbie's perfect life in Barbieland starts to crack, sending her and Ken into the real world.
P: Serve the waffles when Barbie's perfect morning starts to go wrong.
S: Soft white bread rolled flat, spread with strawberry cream cheese and rolled up, sliced into pink pinwheels.
the beach where Ken's job is just beach
Watermelon, strawberries, pineapple and kiwi fruit threaded onto skewers, chilled and served with a honey yoghurt dip.
Eggs boiled, whites tinted pink in beetroot juice, yolks whipped with mayo and mustard and piped back in.
M: Pasta tossed in a sauce of roasted beetroot blended with ricotta, garlic and parmesan, topped with goat's cheese.
Pork ribs rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, slow baked and glazed with barbecue sauce until sticky.
W: Fluffy golden waffles piled with fresh strawberries, whipped cream and a bright pink strawberry sauce poured over the top.
K: pink, cold and actually in the cup
Strawberries blended with cold milk and a little honey until pink and frothy.

s.how: Blitz 100g strawberries and beat into 250g cream cheese. Trim the crusts from 8 slices white bread and roll each flat. Spread with the pink cream cheese, roll up tightly, chill 20 minutes and slice into pinwheels.

s.note: the beach where Ken's job is just beach
s.how: Cut a quarter of a watermelon and half a pineapple into chunks and halve 250g strawberries and 3 kiwi fruit. Thread onto 12 skewers in a rainbow and chill. Mix 250g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp honey for dipping.

m.how: Roast 3 beetroot wrapped in foil at 200C for 50 minutes, peel and blend with 250g ricotta, 1 garlic clove, 40g parmesan and a splash of pasta water. Toss through 500g cooked penne until glossy and pink, and crumble 100g goat's cheese over the top.

w.how: Make 8 waffles from 300g waffle mix. Blitz 150g strawberries with 2 tbsp sugar for a pink sauce. Whip 300ml cream. Stack the waffles with cream, 250g sliced strawberries and the pink sauce poured over.

d.note: pink, cold and actually in the cup
d.how: Blend 300g hulled strawberries with 1L cold milk and 2 tbsp honey until smooth and frothy. Strain if you like it silky and pour into 4 glasses over ice.
